name: Dispute Letter Drafts
business_problem: Card dispute teams send outcome letters that must cite the scheme rules applied. Drafted letters could reduce turnaround, but every letter is customer facing and legally significant, so the review path needs a legal approval step first.
health_rule: Owner, business case, current approvals, spend within budget, no open incident
last_decision: Letters need legal sign-off workflow before review

name: Meeting Notes
business_problem: Teams lose decisions and action items from internal meetings because nobody owns the notes. Automatic summaries with owners and due dates would make follow-up reliable and reduce the number of repeat meetings held only to recover what was already agreed.
health_rule: Owner, business case, current approvals, spend within budget, no open incident

name: Mortgage Document Q&A
business_problem: Mortgage underwriters search long application packs for specific facts such as income sources and existing commitments. Answers with exact page citations could speed underwriting while the underwriter remains responsible for every lending decision.
health_rule: Owner, business case, current approvals, spend within budget, no open incident

name: Travel Expense Checker
business_problem: Finance staff check expense claims against travel policy by hand and miss duplicate receipts. Automated checks that flag likely policy breaches would focus reviewers on the claims that matter, while approvers keep the final decision on every claim.
health_rule: Owner, business case, current approvals, spend within budget, no open incident

name: Branch Staffing Insights
business_problem: Regional managers set branch staffing from last year's patterns and react late to changes in footfall. Plain language insights from visit and transaction data could help them plan rosters weeks ahead and reduce both overtime and long queues.
health_rule: Owner, business case, current approvals, spend within budget, no open incident

name: Invoice Extraction
business_problem: Accounts payable staff key invoice fields into the ledger by hand, which causes late payments and duplicate entries. Extracting fields automatically with confidence checks could cut manual keying while staff handle every exception and approval.
health_rule: No active owner

name: Data Catalog Descriptions
business_problem: Thousands of tables in the data catalog have no descriptions, so analysts guess at meanings or ask around. Drafted descriptions from schemas and query history would make data easier to find, with data owners approving each description they publish.
health_rule: Owner, business case, current approvals, spend within budget, no open incident

name: Marketing Copy Variants
business_problem: Marketing produces many variants of campaign copy for testing, and each variant needs compliance review for financial promotion rules. Generated variants could widen testing, but only if compliance review capacity keeps pace with the volume.
health_rule: Owner, business case, current approvals, spend within budget, no open incident
last_decision: Rejected at review: no approval path for financial promotions

name: AML Case Assistant
business_problem: Investigators assemble anti money laundering cases from transaction histories and customer records before filing reports. An assistant that gathers evidence and drafts a timeline could speed investigations while investigators make every filing decision.
health_rule: Owner, business case, current approvals, spend within budget, no open incident

name: KYC Document Checker
business_problem: Onboarding staff check identity documents by hand against a long checklist, which delays account opening by two days on average. The checker flags missing or inconsistent fields so staff review only the exceptions, while every final approval stays with a person.
health_rule: Owner, business case, current approvals, spend within budget, no open incident

name: Branch FAQ Bot
business_problem: Branch staff call the central help line with product questions while customers wait at the counter. An internal assistant answering from approved product sheets would shorten those waits and leave unusual questions to the help line team.
health_rule: Owner, business case, current approvals, spend within budget, no open incident

name: Policy Q&A
business_problem: Managers ask HR the same questions about leave, travel, and expenses every week. A question answering service grounded in current policies would answer most of them instantly and send the remainder to HR with the context already attached.
health_rule: Owner, business case, current approvals, spend within budget, no open incident

name: Fraud Alert Summaries
business_problem: Fraud analysts open five systems to understand one alert before deciding whether to block a card. A short evidence summary per alert could cut review time, but a wrong summary could hide a real fraud signal, so it must be shadowed before anyone relies on it.
health_rule: Owner, business case, current approvals, spend within budget, no open incident

name: Procurement Intake
business_problem: Purchase requests arrive as free text emails and procurement staff rewrite each one into the request form. Converting requests into structured forms would cut handling time and reduce back and forth with requesters about missing details.
health_rule: Owner, business case, current approvals, spend within budget, no open incident

name: Developer Code Review Aid

name: Wealth Portfolio Letters

health_rule: Owner, business case, current approvals, spend within budget, no open incident

name: Training Quiz Builder

health_rule: Owner, business case, current approvals, spend within budget, no open incident

name: Support Triage
business_problem: Agents read every inbound banking support message to decide which queue owns it. Misrouted fraud and lost-card reports wait in the wrong queue, and routine requests consume time that specialists need for complex cases. We want routing recommendations that a person can trust or override.
health_rule: Owner, business case, current approvals, spend within budget, no open incident

name: Variance Explainer
business_problem: Finance analysts explain monthly budget variances line by line in spreadsheets, and the same explanations recur every month. Suggested explanations drafted from prior months and ledger detail could shorten close while analysts approve every line.

name: Complaint Classifier
business_problem: Regulated complaints must be identified and acknowledged within strict deadlines. Staff currently tag complaints by hand, and late tagging creates regulatory exposure. Automatic tagging with human confirmation could protect those deadlines across all channels.
health_rule: Owner, business case, current approvals, spend within budget, no open incident

name: ESG Report Assistant

name: Treasury Cash Forecast Notes

name: Call Center QA Scoring
business_problem: Quality teams score about two percent of calls by hand, so coaching relies on a small sample. Scoring every call against the quality rubric would show trends across all agents, with quality leads reviewing scores before any coaching conversation.

name: HR Case Summaries

health_rule: Owner, business case, current approvals, spend within budget, no open incident
